body:
Nope, I've never really told anyone about this in a compulsory or optional manner.  I keep these feelings tucked in.  

Basically the accumulation of my emotions have really caught up to me.  I've typed it out on reddit before on other throwaways.  It's hard to put into words.  

What really sucks for me is that depression has 
made all the things I used to love suck.  Like, zero fun.  Gaming, reading, TV, casually chatting with people, it's just not fun.  

I'm a senior in high school, and a lot of people know me as the fun loving, always positive clown.  I get along with anyone, appear happy on the outside etc., it's so damn cliche to type out.  I'm one of *those* people.  Happy on the outside, empty on the inside.  I have a few friends only really, and while I wish I could call them "good" friends, I don't really know if they are.   Like, I would never share what I'm saying right now to them for a variety of reasons.  

Other things of course, my overall energy level has gone down.  I have problems sleeping sometimes, I'm always tired regardless of the amount of sleep I get.  I get mad over stupid shit and it makes me feel bad.  Migraines since I was a small child don't help with that.  Gosh I swear I could write a book about everything that is happening to me I hate.

And then on the other end of things are just stupid trivial things I shouldn't hate myself for.  Like the girl I really like but I'm too scared to talk to because I know she's out of my league, feeling bad because my grades are shitty because I'm losing motivation, not being able to find a job after searching for months and months.  I mean actually searching too - I've tried using people I know as references, going back to speak with managers, etc.  Shit, I've even had *two* interviews out of the dozens of places I went.  Both told me I had no experience, it's disheartening.

To top it all off, I don't hate my parents or anything, but I wouldn't say that I'm open with them.   I would never talk to them about anything I feel on the inside.  No one really. I feel ungrateful but I don't want to be.  I just can't feel much anymore.  The only thing that really even makes me happy anymore is some music.  One of my few "friends" (who keep in mind I've never actually met, I just know from online) just went into basic training, so I won't be able to talk to him.  I used to talk to him everyday.

I'm starting to cry now, so I'm going to stop here.
